definitions.explanation: The state or condition of something.

examples.japanese: {具合|ぐあい}が{悪|わる}いので、{休|やす}みます。
examples.english: I'm not feeling well, so I'll take the day off.

examples.japanese: エアコンの{具合|ぐあい}が{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: The air conditioner isn't working properly.

notes:
Common expressions:
- {具合|ぐあい}が{悪|わる}い - not feeling well; not working properly
- {具合|ぐあい}が{良|い}い - feeling good; working well
- いい{具合|ぐあい}に - just right, nicely
